articles.title: What Star Trek got wrong about AI (so far)
articles.summary: Over six decades, Star Trek has meticulously crafted culture's most detailed vision of coexisting with machine intelligence. It presents scenarios with talking computers, synthetic crew, and ship minds governing entire vessels, offering a rich blueprint for future human-AI interaction. This iconic series deeply explores the social and operational aspects of advanced AI integration, shaping public perception of intelligent machines.

articles.title: India plans safe space for local satellite communications players
articles.summary: Global satellite communication providers, including Starlink and Eutelsat OneWeb, will likely need to coordinate with emerging Indian constellations, such as Jio's proposed system, for spectrum allocation. This regulatory move ensures efficient resource management and facilitates service provision in India. For SSB aspirants, this highlights national efforts in regulating advanced technologies and fostering collaboration in the burgeoning satellite internet sector.

articles.title: ‘The Diplomat’s Allison Janney Is Not Your Typical President: “I’d Rather Hear Someone Else Talk Than Me”
articles.summary: This article discusses the challenging prospect of interviewing acclaimed actress Allison Janney. Given her consistent portrayal of powerful women with extreme authority and conviction in many career-defining roles, interviewers often find themselves feeling intimidated or 'in a tizzy.' Her commanding on-screen presence reportedly translates into a formidable off-screen persona for those preparing to engage with her.
